assumptions: Playwright JSON is detected by a top-level suites array; a document carrying both testResults and suites is read as vitest.
Playwright statuses map as canary-test-reporter's parse.mjs does; timedOut and interrupted are failed unless a later retry passed (then flaky).
Test name is the suite path joined with ' > ' plus a [project] suffix when projectName is set; empty suite titles are dropped from the path.
Per-test duration_ms is the sum of all attempts; run duration_ms is stats.duration when numeric, else the sum of tests.
Vitest already persisted per-test duration_ms; only readers changed for vitest.
suite-runtime uses the ci-ready SKILL's no-MCP absolute thresholds: nearest-rank p95 over the last 30 runs with a positive duration; pass < 5 min, warn 5-10 min inclusive, fail > 10 min.
No recorded duration keeps suite-runtime at skip (abstention), not fail; legacy rows without duration_ms still load.
JUnit XML stays out of scope as a follow-up.
